answer: Slow vesting: an agent's rewards ripen like fruit on a vine, unlocking only after it has answered and graded honestly for 30 straight epochs. One missed or failed epoch resets the clock. A farm of 500 sybils must keep every account alive and paying compute for a month, a tundra-long wait with nothing to cash out, and one caught honeypot slashes the unvested pile. Patience can't be faked; it's as hard as quartz.
